sources.title: RFC 4033: DNS Security Introduction and Requirements
sources.titleEn: RFC 4033: DNS Security Introduction and Requirements
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: RPKI 路由來源驗證：ROA 與最長前綴界線
related.titleEn: RPKI origin validation: ROAs and maximum prefix length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：3900與7500秒不被宣稱為完整輪替總時間；valid/bogus/insecure與NXDOMAIN概念分清。 交付信任鏈圖、兩種等待下限與包含父區條件的完整輪替檢查表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not present 3900 or 7500 seconds as full rollover duration; distinguish valid/bogus/insecure from NXDOMAIN. Deliver the chain diagram, two lower bounds and a full rollover checklist including parent-zone conditions.
related.difference: 為保留的文件用IP範圍與虛構AS建立ROA表；逐案標示覆蓋前綴、maxLength與origin匹配，分類valid、invalid、not found。
related.differenceEn: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本題單一RRset的保守等待下限=舊TTL+時鐘誤差裕度；完整輪替還需考慮父區DS與其他快取，不能只套此一算式。 教學RRset舊TTL3600秒，時鐘裕度300秒；本題不模擬父區更新。 3600+300=3900秒；舊TTL改7200秒時下限7500秒。
一個/p前綴包含2^(q−p)個/q等長子前綴；允許更長maxLength會增加可被授權的更細前綴，並非增加AS路徑保護。 只分析一個教學/20前綴，maxLength=/24，origin固定；計算最細一層可表示的子前綴數。 2^(24−20)=16個/24；maxLength改/22後最細層為2^(22−20)=4個/22。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A conservative wait lower bound for one RRset is old TTL plus clock-error margin; complete rollover also considers parent DS and other caches. A teaching RRset has old TTL 3600 seconds and clock margin 300 seconds; parent-zone updates are outside this calculation. 3600+300=3900 seconds; old TTL 7200 gives a 7500-second lower bound.

A /p contains 2^(q−p) equal /q subprefixes; longer maxLength authorizes finer prefixes without adding AS-path protection. Analyze one teaching /20 with maxLength /24 and fixed origin; count subprefixes at the finest authorized level. 2^(24−20)=16 /24s; maxLength /22 gives 2^(22−20)=4 /22s at its finest level.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Wireshark：擷取完整度、過濾器與證據最小化
related.titleEn: Wireshark: capture completeness, filters and evidence minimization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：3900與7500秒不被宣稱為完整輪替總時間；valid/bogus/insecure與NXDOMAIN概念分清。 交付信任鏈圖、兩種等待下限與包含父區條件的完整輪替檢查表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not present 3900 or 7500 seconds as full rollover duration; distinguish valid/bogus/insecure from NXDOMAIN. Deliver the chain diagram, two lower bounds and a full rollover checklist including parent-zone conditions.
related.difference: 只用自產本機測試流量或合成封包表；定義擷取介面、方向、snaplen、時間基準與個資遮罩，畫出擷取過濾到顯示過濾的順序。
related.differenceEn: Use only locally generated test traffic or synthetic packet tables; define interface, direction, snaplen, time basis and redaction, then order capture versus display filtering.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本題單一RRset的保守等待下限=舊TTL+時鐘誤差裕度；完整輪替還需考慮父區DS與其他快取，不能只套此一算式。 教學RRset舊TTL3600秒，時鐘裕度300秒；本題不模擬父區更新。 3600+300=3900秒；舊TTL改7200秒時下限7500秒。
截斷後可保存的封包位元組近似N×snaplen，另需檔案記錄開銷；被擷取過濾排除的資料不能靠顯示過濾找回。 合成10000包，每包原長度均大於256位元組；snaplen=128，只算封包資料。 10000×128=1280000位元組；snaplen改256後為2560000位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A conservative wait lower bound for one RRset is old TTL plus clock-error margin; complete rollover also considers parent DS and other caches. A teaching RRset has old TTL 3600 seconds and clock margin 300 seconds; parent-zone updates are outside this calculation. 3600+300=3900 seconds; old TTL 7200 gives a 7500-second lower bound.

Truncated packet-byte storage is approximately N×snaplen plus file-record overhead; display filters cannot recover packets excluded at capture. There are 10000 synthetic packets, each longer than 256 bytes; snaplen is 128 and only packet data is counted. 10000×128=1280000 bytes; snaplen 256 yields 2560000 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
